home.meta_title: Pulse Flow: run the whole property operation in one place
home.meta_description: Properties, jobs, vendors, bills and guests in one workspace. Owner, manager and staff see the same picture, each in their own language.
home.og_title: Get your property operation out of the group chat
home.og_description: Owner, manager, staff and guest in one workspace. Everyone sees their own slice, in their own language.
home.og_image_alt: Pulse Flow: properties, jobs, money and guests on one screen
home.headline: Get your operation out of the group chat
home.sub: Properties, jobs, vendors, bills and guests in one workspace. Everyone sees their own slice, in their own language.
home.proof_line: We are launching on Koh Phangan, onboarding the first teams by hand. Reviews will appear here when there are real ones.
home.alt_title: Right now this lives in WhatsApp with your manager, LINE with your cleaner, and a spreadsheet
home.alt_1: You send a job and have no idea whether anyone picked it up until you call.
home.alt_2: Receipts sit as photos in a thread, and at month end you go looking for them again.
home.alt_3: Someone leaves, and the vendor numbers and the arrangements leave with their phone.
home.alt_answer: The chat is not going anywhere, and it should not. Pulse Flow picks up where the chat stops working: a job that is confirmed, a cost attached to a property, and a history that stays with the company.
home.card_villas_desc: Status, map pin, stay dates, notes and a photo. One list for the owner, the manager and the person on site, instead of three versions of a spreadsheet.
home.card_jobs_desc: A job with a description and a work window. Anyone on the app confirms it with one tap. For everyone else, call or message straight from the contact card: phone, WhatsApp, LINE.
home.card_money_desc: An expense with a photo of the receipt, attached to a property and a category. Total, paid and pending, three numbers in front of you. Twenty currencies with conversion.
home.card_guests_desc: House rules your guest ticks as read, a deposit with every deduction and the balance, and a direct date request from a returning guest.
home.lang_title: One language for the whole team
home.lang_desc: The manager writes the job in English, the cleaner reads it in Thai, the owner sees it in Russian. This is not a separate translator, it is a switch in the profile: jobs, team chat, messages and guest briefings arrive in whatever language each person chose. A spreadsheet cannot do that, and neither can a chat thread.
home.why_title: Look at it from your side
home.why_lead: Every role gets its own screen. Open the one that is about you.
home.audience_owner_desc: See occupancy, urgent work and spend without asking anyone.
home.audience_manager_desc: Build the day once, hand the shift over with its history.
home.audience_staff_desc: See your jobs, take them, send receipts from your phone.
home.guest_note: Invited guests get their own screen too: house rules, deposit and date requests.
home.plan_title: The owner pays. The team does not.
home.plan_free_team: Managers, field staff and guests you invite use the app for free, however many of them there are. There is no per-seat charge.
home.plan_personal_desc: One or two properties, you do it all yourself. Free forever.
home.plan_company_desc: You have a manager, a cleaner or vendors. Only the owner pays, one subscription covers the team.
home.plan_note: Billing is not switched on yet. Every registered account gets 3 months of full access from the day it signs up.
home.referral_title: Invite 5 people, get a year of Full free
home.referral_lead: Your referral link is in your profile. Signing up for the app counts, and so does joining your company as staff. Five credited joins unlock a year of Full, counted from the day billing starts or the end of your three free months, whichever comes later.
home.faq_q1: Everything is on Airbnb and Booking. Does this replace them?
home.faq_a1: No. Bookings stay where they are. Pulse Flow is about what happens after the booking: who cleans, what broke, what it cost, and what the guest can see. Check-in and check-out dates are entered by hand today. Importing bookings from Google Calendar is planned. There is no direct sync with Airbnb or Booking.
home.faq_a2: A personal workspace is free forever. For a company, only the owner pays, and team seats are free. Billing is not live yet, so every registered account has 3 months of full access.
home.faq_q3: My cleaners will never install an app.
home.faq_a3: There is nothing to install from a store. It opens from a link in the browser and goes onto the phone's home screen in one step. No Google account, no App Store, just an email address. The interface follows the language each person picks, and so do the jobs and the chat.
home.faq_q4: Do guests have to install anything?
home.faq_a4: No, a guest opens the link their host sends. No payment goes through the app: deposits and payments go straight to the host, and the app records the amount, the deductions and the balance so both sides see the same thing.
home.demo_lead: Owner, manager, staff and guest logins, already filled in.
home.close_title: Open the app and look at your day
home.close_lead: The pulse of your rental operations: what is happening right now, and where it goes next.

owners.meta_description: Occupancy, urgent work and every cost by property, without calling your manager. Jobs that get confirmed, receipts by photo, free seats for the team.

owners.more_g1_li3: Assign specific properties to specific people

managers.meta_title: For managers: the day, jobs and handover · Pulse Flow
managers.meta_description: What is urgent today, who is doing it and how it ended. Jobs get confirmed, and the owner report builds itself out of what already happened.
managers.og_description: Build the day once, not again in every chat.
managers.og_image_alt: Manager screen: readiness, check-ins and urgent work
managers.headline: Build the day once, not again in every chat
managers.sub: What is urgent, who is on site, which check-ins are coming and which bills are open. Your owner sees the same thing and stops asking.
managers.free_note: Your seat is free. The company owner pays.
managers.alt_1: The plan for the day gets rebuilt across three chats every morning.
managers.alt_2: The owner asks for status and you reassemble the answer by hand.
managers.alt_3: The cleaner never saw the message, and you find out from the guest.
managers.f1_desc: Readiness, occupancy, turnovers between stays and urgent work on one screen. Below it, the week's check-ins and the volume of open work, without rebuilding the plan in a thread.
managers.f1_alt: Manager home screen: readiness, check-ins and urgent work
managers.f2_title: The job went out and somebody took it
managers.f2_desc: What, where and when, in one send. Anyone on the app confirms with a tap and both you and the owner see it. Anyone easier to reach by phone, reach from the same card: call, WhatsApp, LINE.
managers.f2_alt: Job card: property, work window and confirmation status
managers.f3_title: The report builds itself out of what already happened
managers.f3_desc: Tasks, bills, check-ins and work for a period export by category or all at once. The weekly handover stops being something you type up on Friday.
managers.f3_alt: Reports screen: category and period selection, data export
managers.lang_title: One language for the whole team
managers.lang_desc: You write the job once. The cleaner reads it in Thai, the owner in Russian, the vendor in English. Jobs, team chat and guest briefings are translated, not just the interface.
managers.roles_lead: You have the same operational access as the owner. Three things are not yours: the organisation's own details, editing the company property list, and handing out property access to staff. That stays with the owner, and it is a division of responsibility rather than a restriction.
managers.more_g1_li3: Weekly endorsements and a company leaderboard
managers.more_g1_li4: Staff search: skills, area, map, reviews
managers.more_g2_li1: Company-wide tasks with mine and urgent filters
managers.more_g2_li2: Vendor book with call, WhatsApp and LINE
managers.more_g2_li4: House guide and notes on every property
managers.more_g2_li5: Guests: deposits, deductions, briefings, date requests
managers.more_g3_li1: Reports and exports, by category or all of it
managers.more_g3_li2: Finance: filters, totals, mark as paid
managers.faq_q1: One more system to keep updated by hand.
managers.faq_a1: It is entered where the work happens: the job is created from the contact card, the receipt is photographed by the person who paid, the property status changes on site. managers.faq_a3: Change the organisation's details, edit the company property list, or assign properties to another manager. Everything else is the same as the owner's. Billing is not yours either.

managers.soon_3: Connect directly to Airbnb or Booking. Not today and not on the near roadmap.

staff.meta_description: See what is yours today, in your language. Take a job with one tap, send a receipt as a photo, and keep the ratings you earn.

staff.og_image_alt: Staff screen: today's jobs and one-tap confirmation
staff.headline: Your jobs for today, in your language
staff.sub: No scrolling back through a chat. Take the job with one tap, send the receipt as a photo, and it all stays in one place.
staff.free_note: It is free for you. The company that invited you pays.
staff.alt_1: The job arrived in a chat and scrolled away under everything else.
staff.alt_2: Receipts sit on your phone and you get paid back when someone remembers.
staff.alt_3: The job is written in a language you do not work in.

staff.f1_alt: Staff home screen: a job waiting to be confirmed
staff.f2_title: One tap and it is yours
staff.f2_desc: A job only counts as yours once you confirm it. The owner and the manager see that immediately, so nobody has to ask whether you got it.
staff.f2_alt: A job before confirmation and after
staff.f3_desc: Photograph the receipt, type the amount, send. You can see your own submissions and where they are; the owner approves them. No paper to carry and no reminding anyone.
staff.f3_alt: Submitting an expense: amount, receipt photo and status
staff.lang_desc: Pick your language in your profile, and jobs, team chat and messages from the owner arrive in it, even when they were written in another. The content is translated, not just the buttons.

If you want it, switch yourself into staff search and your skills, area, map pin and reviews become visible to other companies nearby. The switch turns off any time. staff.own_alt: Staff search profile: skills, area and visibility switch
staff.more_g1_li1: Assigned properties with status and dates
staff.more_g1_li2: Jobs with work windows, by property
staff.more_g2_li1: Your own properties for your own clients
staff.more_g2_li2: A profile with skills, area and a map pin
staff.more_g2_li4: Invite people you know with your own link

staff.faq_a1: No. It opens from a link in the browser and goes onto your home screen in one step. No Google Play, no App Store, no new account. An email address is enough.
staff.faq_q2: Will my boss see everything about me?
staff.faq_a2: They see your jobs on their properties and the receipts you send. The properties you keep for yourself are not visible to them. You only appear in staff search if you switch it on.

guests.meta_title: Guests: gate code, house rules and deposit · Pulse Flow
guests.meta_description: Your host sent you a link. Inside: house rules, the gate code, a chat with your host and your deposit with the balance. Nothing to install.
guests.og_description: House rules, the gate code and your deposit in one place, without messaging anyone.
guests.og_image_alt: Guest screen: villa, stay dates and deposit status
guests.headline: The gate code, the house rules and your deposit
guests.sub: Your host sent you a link. Everything about your stay is on one screen, and that is also where you write if something is not right.
guests.f1_desc: The villa, your dates, anything your host has posted and where your deposit stands, on the first screen.
guests.f1_alt: Guest screen: villa, stay dates and deposit status
guests.f2_desc: Wi-Fi, gate code, quiet hours, bin day and the checkout steps, written by your host. Individual notes get ticked as read, so both of you know you have seen them.
guests.f2_alt: House guide and host briefings with read receipts
guests.f3_desc: What you paid, what was deducted, what for, with a photo, and what is left. You do not have to ask, and you do not have to take anyone's word for it.
guests.f3_alt: Guest deposit: paid, deductions and balance
guests.o1: A chat with your host that opens once your stay is confirmed. Cleaners and contractors are not in it.
guests.o2: Arrival and departure photos, if something is worth recording.
guests.o3: The same host's other villas, and a direct date request for next time.

guests.faq_q1: Do I need to install anything?
guests.faq_a1: No. You open your host's link in a browser. If you want, it goes onto your home screen in one step.
guests.faq_q2: Do I pay through the app?
guests.faq_a2: No. Your deposit and payment go straight to your host, however the two of you agreed. The app shows the amounts, the deductions and the balance so that you both have the same version.
guests.faq_q3: Can I book my next stay here?
guests.faq_a3: You can send your host a date request from the app and they reply with a price. It is not one-click booking and it is not a payment, it is a direct request without a platform and its fee.

terms.summary_li1: Pulse Flow is operations software for property teams, not a landlord, employer, payment processor, or travel agency.

terms.summary_li3: Personal workspaces are free. Company billing applies to the owner when subscriptions are live.
terms.summary_li4: Do not misuse chat, upload harmful content, or process data you are not authorized to handle.
terms.summary_li5: We may update these Terms and suspend accounts that create risk.
terms.guest_intro: Stay guests request dates, receive quotes, confirm stays, chat in Support, and track deposits. Your host sets price, deposit rules, and payment instructions.
terms.guest_li1: Deposits are paid directly to your host. Send /deposit in Support with a receipt; your host confirms when received.
terms.guest_li2: Cancel at least 3 days before check-in from Stay home; within 3 days send /cancel in Support.
terms.guest_li3: Your host may cancel if a before-arrival deposit stays unpaid or unconfirmed.
terms.guest_li4: Refunds and house rules are between you and your host.
terms.owner_intro: You operate properties, invite team and guests, and are responsible for rental agreements, pricing, deposits, refunds, and local compliance.
terms.owner_li1: Send clear quotes with deposit timing and payment instructions.
terms.owner_li2: Confirm deposits in Guests or Support after checking receipts.
terms.owner_li3: Manage stays, briefings, and cancellations from Guests.
terms.owner_li4: Managers have the same operational access as owners, except organisation details, editing the company property list, and assigning property access.
terms.staff_intro: Field staff use the app for assigned properties, jobs, tasks, team chat, and expense bills. Property access and assignments are controlled by the company owner.
terms.staff_li1: Work only on assigned properties and submit bills per your team's rules.
terms.staff_li2: Pulse Flow is not your employer; pay and supervision are with the company you work for.
terms.staff_li3: Listing yourself in staff search is optional and can be switched off at any time.
terms.staff_li4: Guest stay tools are for invited guests and are not part of the field screens.

Five credited referral joins unlock one year of Full, counted from the day billing starts or the end of your three free months, whichever comes later.

privacy.meta_description: Privacy Policy for Pulse Flow: how we handle account and operations data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Pulse Flow collects, uses, and shares information when you use pulseflow.site, app.pulseflow.site, and related services (the "Service").
privacy.summary_li1: We collect account, operations, and technical data needed to run the Service.
privacy.summary_li2: We use data to authenticate you, deliver features, and send notifications.
privacy.summary_li3: We share data with infrastructure providers, the payment processor when billing is enabled, and teammates according to role.
privacy.summary_li4: We do not sell your personal information.
privacy.guest_li1: We store date requests, quotes, stays, deposit status, briefings, and Support chat (including /deposit and /cancel).
privacy.guest_li2: Receipt images in Support are stored in cloud storage.
privacy.guest_li3: Your host and their team can see booking and Support data for your stay.
privacy.owner_li1: We process property inventory, tasks, contacts, team chat, bills, reports, guest stays, and billing metadata for your organization.
privacy.owner_li2: Guest Support messages and deposit records are visible to authorized owners and managers.
privacy.owner_li3: Payment customer and subscription IDs are stored on the organization; card numbers are handled by the payment processor.
privacy.staff_li1: We store your profile, assigned properties, job confirmations, tasks, team chat, endorsements, and submitted bills.
privacy.staff_li2: Receipt photos for expenses are stored in cloud storage.
privacy.staff_li3: A staff search listing is optional and may be visible to owners and managers searching in the app.
privacy.staff_li4: Guest stay data stays limited to hosts and that guest.
privacy.s4_body: We retain data while your organization is active and for a reasonable period afterward for backups, disputes and legal compliance. We use encrypted transport and access controls. You can request account deletion; some records may be retained where the law requires it.
privacy.s5_li1: Update profile and organization settings in the app
privacy.s5_li2: Manage or cancel company billing via the billing portal when available
privacy.s5_li3: Contact us to access, correct, or delete personal data where applicable
privacy.s6_body: Data may be processed outside your home country, in the regions our providers operate in. The Service is intended for business operations and is not directed at children under 16.
privacy.s7_body: We may update this Policy and post a revised date. Continued use means you accept the updated Policy.
privacy.s8_body: Privacy questions: support@pulseflow.site. See also our Terms of Service.
